record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> O God<WH0430>, the heathen<WH01471> are come<WH0935><WTH8804> into thine inheritance<WH05159>; thy holy<WH06944> temple<WH01964> have they defiled<WH02930><WTH8765>; they have laid<WH07760><WTH8804> Jerusalem<WH03389> on heaps<WH05856>. <RF>of: or, for<Rf>

The dead bodies<WH05038> of thy servants<WH05650> have they given<WH05414><WTH8804> <FI>to be<Fi> meat<WH03978> unto the fowls<WH05775> of the heaven<WH08064>, the flesh<WH01320> of thy saints<WH02623> unto the beasts<WH02416> of the earth<WH0776>.
Their blood<WH01818> have they shed<WH08210><WTH8804> like water<WH04325> round about<WH05439> Jerusalem<WH03389>; and <FI>there was<Fi> none to bury<WH06912><WTH8802> <FI>them<Fi> .
We are become a reproach<WH02781> to our neighbours<WH07934>, a scorn<WH03933> and derision<WH07047> to them that are round about<WH05439> us.
How long, LORD<WH03068>? wilt thou be angry<WH0599><WTH8799> for ever<WH05331>? shall thy jealousy<WH07068> burn<WH01197><WTH8799> like fire<WH0784>?<CM>

Pour out<WH08210><WTH8798> thy wrath<WH02534> upon the heathen<WH01471> that have not known<WH03045><WTH8804> thee, and upon the kingdoms<WH04467> that have not called<WH07121><WTH8804> upon thy name<WH08034>.
For they have devoured<WH0398><WTH8804> Jacob<WH03290>, and laid waste<WH08074><WTH8689> his dwelling place<WH05116>.

O remember<WH02142><WTH8799> not against us former<WH07223> iniquities<WH05771>: let thy tender mercies<WH07356> speedily<WH04118> prevent<WH06923><WTH8762> us: for we are brought<WH01809><WH00> very<WH03966> low<WH01809><WTH8804>. <RF>former...: or, the iniquities of them that were before us<Rf>

Help<WH05826><WTH8798> us, O God<WH0430> of our salvation<WH03468>, for<WH01697> the glory<WH03519> of thy name<WH08034>: and deliver<WH05337><WTH8685> us, and purge away<WH03722><WTH8761> our sins<WH02403>, for thy name's<WH08034> sake.

Wherefore should the heathen<WH01471> say<WH0559><WTH8799>, Where <FI>is<Fi> their God<WH0430>? let him be known<WH03045><WTH8735> among the heathen<WH01471> in our sight<WH05869> <FI>by<Fi> the revenging<WH05360> of the blood<WH01818> of thy servants<WH05650> <FI>which is<Fi> shed<WH08210><WTH8803>. <RF>revenging: Heb. vengeance<Rf>

Let the sighing<WH0603> of the prisoner<WH0615> come<WH0935><WTH8799> before<WH06440> thee; according to the greatness<WH01433> of thy power<WH02220> preserve<WH03498><WTH8685> thou those that are appointed<WH01121> to die<WH08546>; <RF>thy...: Heb. thine arm<Rf> <RF>preserve...: Heb. reserve the children of death<Rf>
And render<WH07725><WTH8685> unto our neighbours<WH07934> sevenfold<WH07659> into their bosom<WH02436> their reproach<WH02781>, wherewith they have reproached<WH02778><WTH8765> thee, O Lord<WH0136>.

So we thy people<WH05971> and sheep<WH06629> of thy pasture<WH04830> will give thee thanks<WH03034><WTH8686> for ever<WH05769>: we will shew forth<WH05608><WTH8762> thy praise<WH08416> to all<WH01755> generations<WH01755>. <RF>to all...: Heb. to generation and generation<Rf><CM>
